REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 23, 2010 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.

4.

Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar*
*7. Registers of Demands for 9/23/10.
*8. Minutes for 9/9/10.

9A.
Biennial Notice to the City Council regarding review of City/Redevelopment Agency/Public Financing Authority Conflict of Interest Codes.
9B.
Request of the Artesia-Cerritos Woman’s Club regarding its February 1, 2011 City Council Candidate forum.
End of Consent Calendar
10.
Public Hearings
10A.
Review and consideration of the 2008-2014 Housing Element Update of the Cerritos General Plan, Negative Declaration. Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CERTIFYING THE NEGATIVE DECLARATION PREPARED IN SUPPORT OF THE 2008-2014 HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE. Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVING THE 2008-2014 HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE.
11.

11A.
Consideration to waive reading and adopt A RESOLUTION BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS IN SUPPORT OF "BUSINESS FRIENDLY PRINCIPLES" AS PART OF THE SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS’ (SCAG) DEVELOPMENT OF A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ECONOMIC GROWTH STRATEGY.
12.

12A.
Consideration and award of a contract for the preparation of the City of Cerritos Water Division 2010 Urban Water Management Plan
13.
New and Old Business
13A.
Consideration of an assessment schedule and the allocation of funding for the preparation of the Gateway Cities Council of Government’s (COG) sustainable communities strategy (SCS) required pursuant to the provisions of Senate bill 375 (SB 375)
14.

14A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
14B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
